suggestions.action: Prioritize and use strong hook lines/title formulas for "Result Declared" and "Admit Card Out" news across both YouTube and Instagram.
suggestions.why: YouTube's top performers include "AIIMS NORCET 11 Stage 1 Result" (8170 views) and "ISRO ICRB Admit Card" (1628 views), indicating high user interest.

suggestions.action: Incorporate "#Shorts" directly into YouTube video title formulas for urgent news updates like "Admit Card Out" or "Exam Date Announced."
suggestions.why: Videos like "IOCL 2026 Admit Card & Exam Date Out! #Shorts" (1381 views) and "NMDC Steel Executive Trainee Exam Date 2026 #Shorts" (1341 views) performed strongly.

suggestions.action: Optimize Instagram captions with clear calls to action and urgency for application/registration news, leveraging relevant emojis.
suggestions.why: Instagram's top views are for "IIT JAM 2027 application process" (144 views) and "IBPS RRB 2026 applications close" (114 views).

suggestions.action: Re-evaluate the hook-line pool and overall strategy for non-urgent 'strategy' or 'preparation' videos.
suggestions.why: The YouTube video "24 hours left for IES/ESE 2026? Maximize your score | Final Day Strategy" received 0 views, indicating low engagement.

suggestions.action: Implement robust pre-publish checks within the YouTube publishing pipeline to eliminate instances of content with 0 views and ensure proper indexing.
suggestions.why: A significant portion of YouTube content (29 out of 165 videos) received 0 views, indicating a critical technical/publishing failure.

suggestions.action: Refine YouTube title formulas for news recap reels to consistently feature urgent keywords (e.g., "OUT!", "RELEASED!") and numerical highlights like vacancy counts or candidate numbers.
suggestions.why: High-performing YouTube videos like "CIL MT Answer Key OUT!" (4312 views) and "AVNL 20,000+ candidates" (1545 views) use these effectively.

suggestions.action: Mandate accurate vertical assignment for all YouTube news recap videos, replacing 'unknown', to enable use of specific per-vertical hashtag sets.
suggestions.why: Over 70% of YouTube videos are 'unknown', preventing targeted hashtag optimization and hindering performance analysis per exam vertical.

suggestions.action: Revamp Instagram captions and cover/thumbnail frame choices for Reels, also exploring adjustments to video pacing/length based on platform trends.
suggestions.why: Instagram Reels show extremely low engagement (most under 20 views, almost all 0 likes), significantly underperforming YouTube content.

suggestions.action: Prioritize news recap reels covering exam results, admit cards, answer keys, cutoffs, and recruitment notifications, making up 80%+ of content.
suggestions.why: Videos on these topics consistently garnered the highest views, e.g., 'CIL MT Answer Key' (4248 views), 'CTET' (1534 views).

suggestions.action: Update YouTube title formulas and Instagram captions to explicitly use urgent language like 'OUT NOW!', 'LAST DATE!', 'DEADLINE NEARS' for time-sensitive news.
suggestions.why: Urgency drives views; 'CIL MT Answer Key' (4248 views) and 'CTET Sep Application Closing' (621 YT, 11 IG views) highlight this.

suggestions.action: For news recap reels, especially those around answer keys or grievances, craft Gemini-written YouTube descriptions and IG captions with explicit calls for comments (e.g., 'Share your score!').
suggestions.why: The 'CIL MT Answer Key' video, prompting 'Raise Objections', achieved the highest comments (17), indicating strong engagement potential.

suggestions.action: Increase the frequency and breadth of news recap reels specifically for the 'schooling' (CTET, CBSE) and 'govt' (IBPS, SSC) exam verticals.
suggestions.why: The 'schooling' (CTET, 1534 views) and 'govt' (IBPS PO, 837 views) verticals had top-performing videos when identified.

suggestions.action: Reduce investment in generic meme-based hook lines and shift the hook-line pool towards direct, benefit-driven, or urgent language for news content.
suggestions.why: The 'Guddu Bhaiya' meme reel yielded moderate views (527 YT, 161 IG) but very low engagement (4 YT likes, 0 IG likes).

suggestions.action: Update YouTube title formulas for news reels: prominently feature "OUT!", "Released!", "LIVE", "Admit Card", "Answer Key", "Result" to convey immediate updates.
suggestions.why: Titles with these keywords show top YouTube views (e.g., CIL MT Answer Key 3455 views, Punjab Lecturer Admit Card 2966 views).

suggestions.action: Enhance YouTube titles and IG captions by integrating "Expected Soon", "Coming Soon", "Anticipated Release" for critical results/admit cards.
suggestions.why: Videos announcing imminent news perform strongly, e.g., SBI PO Prelims Result (1188 views) and Punjab Lecturer Admit Card (2966 views).

suggestions.action: For recruitment/result news, embed specific numbers (vacancies, applicants, qualified candidates) into YouTube titles and IG captions.
suggestions.why: Quantitative figures capture attention, demonstrated by "1013 Vacancies! Punjab Lecturer" (2966 views) and "20,000+ candidates AVNL" (1087 views).

suggestions.action: Reallocate resources from generic "Complete General Awareness Prep" reels; focus content on specific, time-sensitive updates and immediate exam triggers.
suggestions.why: Generic prep videos (e.g., "Indian Economy for CIL Exam Prep" at 5 views) receive significantly fewer views than urgent news.

suggestions.action: Re-evaluate the weekday vertical rotation for "daily quiz reels." Without specific performance data, integrate quizzes into high-performing verticals.
suggestions.why: Data lacks distinct quiz reel performance. News recap reels show clear high-performing examples (e.g., CIL MT, Punjab Lecturer).

suggestions.action: Adjust "weekday vertical rotation" and "hook-line pool" to prioritize "Admit Card", "Result", and "Answer Key" news immediately upon release. Use "Gemini-written" titles emphasizing urgency.
suggestions.why: Videos like "ISRO SDSC SHAR 2026 Exam Date OUT" (1387 views, 18 likes) & "HBSE 10th, 12th Result" (1176 views, 10 comments) drive top engagement.

suggestions.action: Cease publishing "news recap reels" for broad "General Awareness" topics (e.g., History, Economy) on YouTube. Reallocate resources to high-performing news categories.
suggestions.why: "Indian Economy for CIL Exam Prep" (4 views), "Modern Indian History" (10 views) show negligible interest, wasting resources.

suggestions.action: Update "title formulas" and "IG captions" to consistently include exact vacancy/post counts and application deadlines where relevant for news recap reels.
suggestions.why: "IBPS Clerk 2026 application extended | 11,403 Banking Jobs!" (123 views on IG, 103 reach) shows impact of numerical value.

suggestions.action: Prioritize news recap reels for immediate exam status updates, like 'Results', 'Admit Cards', 'Exam Dates', and 'Counselling/Allotment', over general recruitment notifications.
suggestions.why: Urgent news drives highest engagement, e.g., 'CIL MT Exam Date' (12634 views) and 'JEECUP Allotment' (2563 views).

suggestions.action: Refine YouTube titles and Instagram captions to emphasize urgency, include relevant numbers (posts, candidates), and use direct calls to action like 'OUT!', 'LIVE!', 'Check Now!', 'Download NOW!'.
suggestions.why: Top videos feature these elements; 'CIL MT' had 12634 views, 'HBSE 10/12' got 1167 views and 10 comments.

suggestions.action: Reduce the frequency or reformat content-heavy 'complete prep' videos (e.g., 'Indian History for CIL Exam') in the daily reel pipeline.
suggestions.why: These videos consistently underperform, receiving very low views (e.g., 'Indian Economy for CIL Exam Prep' 3 views, 'Modern Indian History' 9 views).

suggestions.action: Adjust the weekday vertical rotation to dedicate more slots to 'schooling' results/updates and 'govt' exam news given their strong engagement.
suggestions.why: Schooling (HBSE 1167 views, CGBSE 685 views) and Govt (IBPS PO 832 views) results show high performance on YouTube.

suggestions.action: Significantly reduce or pause the production and auto-publishing of daily quiz reels. Reallocate resources to increase the frequency of "news recap reels".
suggestions.why: Quiz reels perform poorly (e.g., "HPCL Quiz Challenge" 0 views YT). News reels dominate views (e.g., "CIL MT 2026 Exam" 9427 views YT).

suggestions.action: Refine the hook-line pool and title formulas for "news recap reels" to consistently use urgent, outcome-driven language and highlight numbers (e.g., "OUT!", "Declared!", "X posts!").
suggestions.why: Top news reels use urgent hooks (e.g., "CIL MT 2026 Exam: August dates out!", "1,731 dreams fulfilled! SSC JE 2025 Final Result").

suggestions.action: Conduct an A/B test for Hinglish vs. English voiceovers on top-performing "news recap reels" to determine audience preference and engagement lift.
suggestions.why: Data on Hinglish news reels is too thin for conclusive impact (e.g., "CBSE 10th marks badhne waale hain?" 186 views YT). Need more data.

suggestions.action: Update Gemini prompts for Instagram captions to explicitly include calls-to-action for likes and comments, and experiment with interactive elements within video templates.
suggestions.why: Instagram engagement is low; top-viewed reels rarely exceed 3 likes or 0 comments (e.g., "SSC CGL 2026" 125 views, 3 likes).
